text: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants must abide by Chinese laws and school regulations, have good moral character and be in good health. 2. ​Applications from couples and immediate family members (parents and children) will not be accepted. 3. Applicants need to graduate from high school. 4. The applicant is aged 16-25. 5. Applicant is not a Chinese citizen. 6. Applicants need to pass TOEFL 60 or IELTS 5.5 or Duolingo 90.
